scope: Ten new development attempts, two scenes per cumulative profile. Existing seed1 l0 scenes; not held-out generalization or a noninferiority test. Historical results are separate context, not substituted for this baseline.

changes.baseline: Original assembled prompt, tool schemas and plan prerequisite.
changes.summaries: Remove raw-action-array option; preserve dynamic retrieval and original reference summaries/images.
changes.no_plan: Additionally remove record_plan and its execution prerequisite. No fake plan or empty retrieval prerequisite.
changes.fixed: Additionally replace retrieval and graph expansion with two fixed TRAIN preparation references: right push_T-0000:p01/close and left push_T-0001:p01/close, preserving original payloads and images. Read by arm when useful.
changes.none: Additionally remove the fixed reference tool; retain only observe, measure_planar, execute_chunk. No history is sent.

unchanged: planar measurement and saved goal/residual semantics
dispatch: In profile order, standard/random pair per profile, at most two simultaneous episodes, at least 11000MiB free before each launch and previous cold start ready. Do not cancel another experiment to obtain resources.
stopping: Run all declared cases despite native failures. An unscored attempt or provenance/workflow problem pauses new dispatch; allow the already active paired episode to finish. Preserve every attempt; no automatic retries, substitutions, version changes or full50 expansion.
interpretation: A passing two-case pilot permits further evaluation, not a claim that the removed mechanisms are causally unnecessary. The fixed-reference step changes selection and available content together; it is a simplification candidate, not a pure representation ablation.
